name: Newsletter
description: An email sign-up with a clear promise, one field and visible error/success states. Use it once per page.

fields.name: Variant
fields.helpText: centered is the default. split is a rounded band of two panels: the sign-up on the primary colour on the right, and on the left either the help panel below (when it has a heading) or the heading and text.

fields.name: Text
fields.helpText: What subscribers get and how often. Include the offer if there is one.

fields.name: Field label
fields.helpText: Always visible above the input. Defaults to "Email address" when unset.

fields.name: Placeholder
fields.helpText: An example, never an instruction. Defaults to "name@example.com" when unset.

fields.name: Consent
fields.helpText: One line with a privacy link. Inline links only.

fields.name: Require a consent checkbox
fields.helpText: Adds a checkbox that must be ticked before submitting. Never pre-ticked.

fields.name: Consent checkbox label
fields.helpText: Shown only when the checkbox above is on.

fields.name: Success title
fields.helpText: Defaults to "You're on the list" when unset.

fields.name: Success text
fields.helpText: For example the confirmation step and the welcome code.

fields.name: Form
fields.helpText: The key of the sign-up form on the Forms page. Defaults to "newsletter" when unset.

fields.name: Help heading
fields.helpText: Split variant only. A heading for a panel beside the sign-up, e.g. "Questions before you buy?". No heading, no panel.

fields.name: Contact lines
fields.helpText: Up to 4 lines in the help panel: phone, email, address. Each an icon, a label, an optional link and an optional highlighted note such as opening hours.

fields.name: Icon
fields.helpText: For example phone, mail or map-pin.

fields.name: Link
fields.helpText: tel:, mailto: or a page. Optional.

fields.name: Note
fields.helpText: Shown after the label in green, e.g. "open today until 18:00".

fields.name: Section background
fields.helpText: Defaults to "surface" when unset ("none" in the split variant, whose band brings its own colours).
